CustomField.description: How urgent the work is, synced with the source in both directions. Blank means no priority: Salesforce stores no sentinel, so Jira's en dash priority and an empty Asana Priority field both arrive as blank and a blank pushes back as each one. Which vendor value means which of these is Field_Mapping__mdt rows of type Priority, keyed on ids, never names. Restricted, so an inbound value nobody mapped cannot become a fourth priority by accident: it leaves the field unchanged and is logged. No default, so a record created by hand never gets a priority its source did not have. The order of the values is the priority order the boards sort by.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How urgent this is. Leave blank for no priority. Changes here are sent to Jira or Asana, and changes there arrive here.
CustomField.label: Priority
